sop_modules.name: Bare Drywall Surface Preparation
sop_modules.purpose: Prepare bare drywall surfaces for primer application by removing dust and debris

sop_modules.name: Wall Priming - Roller Application
sop_modules.purpose: Apply primer to bare drywall walls using roller method with brush cut-in

sop_modules.name: Wall Priming - Spray Application with Backroll
sop_modules.purpose: Apply primer to bare drywall walls using airless spray with mandatory wet backroll
sop_modules.notes: Spray and backroll are wet-on-wet operations. Dry rolling is NOT permitted on bare drywall.

sop_modules.name: Ceiling Priming - Roller Application
sop_modules.purpose: Apply primer to bare drywall ceilings using roller method with brush cut-in

sop_modules.name: Ceiling Priming - Spray Application with Backroll
sop_modules.purpose: Apply primer to bare drywall ceilings using airless spray with mandatory wet backroll
sop_modules.notes: Spray and backroll are wet-on-wet operations. Dry rolling is NOT permitted on bare drywall.

sop_modules.name: Primer Inspection and Touch-Up
sop_modules.purpose: Inspect primed surfaces for holidays, flashing, or defects and remediate

sop_modules.name: Post-Prime Sanding
sop_modules.purpose: Light sanding of primed surface to remove nibs and prepare for topcoat

sop_tasks.name: Dust/Vacuum Surface
sop_tasks.description: Remove construction dust from drywall surface using duster, brush, or vacuum
sop_tasks.notes: Critical for adhesion. Pay attention to corners and horizontal ledges.

sop_tasks.name: Cut-In Primer at Edges (Wall - Pre-Trim)
sop_tasks.description: Brush-apply primer at ceiling line and corners only. No trim or fixtures to cut around.
sop_tasks.notes: Pre-trim scenario: Minimal obstruction. Ceiling line and inside corners only. Faster cut-in.

sop_tasks.name: Cut-In Primer at Edges (Wall - Post-Trim)
sop_tasks.description: Brush-apply primer at ceiling line, corners, around door/window casing, outlets, switches, and base trim.
sop_tasks.notes: Post-trim scenario: More obstructions require careful cut-in around installed trim, fixtures, and outlets. Slower pace.

sop_tasks.name: Roll Primer - Wall Field
sop_tasks.description: Apply primer to wall field areas using roller
sop_tasks.notes: Work in sections, maintain wet edge.

sop_tasks.name: Spray Primer - Wall
sop_tasks.description: Apply primer to walls using airless spray equipment. MUST be immediately followed by backroll while wet.
sop_tasks.notes: Spray application only. Backroll task MUST follow immediately. Do not allow to dry before backrolling.

sop_tasks.name: Backroll Primer - Wall (Wet-on-Wet)
sop_tasks.description: Immediately backroll sprayed primer while still wet to ensure proper adhesion and eliminate air pockets
sop_tasks.notes: MANDATORY for bare drywall spray. Must be wet-on-wet. Dry rolling is NOT permitted. Follow spray applicator closely.

sop_tasks.name: Cut-In Primer at Edges (Ceiling - Pre-Trim)
sop_tasks.description: Brush-apply primer at wall-ceiling junction only. No fixtures or trim to cut around.
sop_tasks.notes: Pre-trim scenario: Perimeter cut-in only. No ceiling fixtures installed yet.

sop_tasks.name: Cut-In Primer at Edges (Ceiling - Post-Trim)
sop_tasks.description: Brush-apply primer at wall-ceiling junction and around ceiling fixtures, HVAC registers, and any installed trim.
sop_tasks.notes: Post-trim scenario: More detailed cut-in around fixtures. Slower pace.

sop_tasks.name: Roll Primer - Ceiling Field
sop_tasks.description: Apply primer to ceiling field areas using roller with extension pole
sop_tasks.notes: Work in manageable sections. Overhead ergonomics affect pace.

sop_tasks.name: Spray Primer - Ceiling
sop_tasks.description: Apply primer to ceilings using airless spray equipment. MUST be immediately followed by backroll while wet.
sop_tasks.notes: Spray application only. Backroll task MUST follow immediately. Do not allow to dry before backrolling.

sop_tasks.name: Backroll Primer - Ceiling (Wet-on-Wet)
sop_tasks.description: Immediately backroll sprayed primer while still wet to ensure proper adhesion and eliminate air pockets
sop_tasks.notes: MANDATORY for bare drywall spray. Must be wet-on-wet. Dry rolling is NOT permitted. Overhead work - follow spray applicator closely.

sop_tasks.name: Inspect Primed Surface
sop_tasks.description: Visual inspection of primed surface for holidays, flashing, runs, or defects
sop_tasks.notes: Use work lighting. Mark defects for touch-up.

sop_tasks.name: Touch-Up Primer
sop_tasks.description: Spot-prime missed areas, holidays, or thin spots identified during inspection
sop_tasks.notes: Touch-up as needed. Rate is variable based on inspection findings.

sop_tasks.name: Sand Primed Surface
sop_tasks.description: Light sanding with fine-grit sandpaper or sanding sponge to remove nibs, dust particles, and minor imperfections
sop_tasks.notes: QT4/QT5 task. Light hand sanding, not aggressive. Remove sanding dust before topcoat.

applicability_rules.description: Surface prep (dusting) applies to all variants
Wall roller priming for brush/roll application method on walls
Wall spray priming (with mandatory backroll) for spray application method on walls
Ceiling roller priming for brush/roll application method on ceilings
Ceiling spray priming (with mandatory backroll) for spray application method on ceilings
Inspection applies to QT4 and QT5 quality levels
Post-prime sanding applies to QT4 and QT5 quality levels

project_phase_rules.name: Pre-Trim Installation
project_phase_rules.description: Priming occurs BEFORE baseboard, door/window casing, ceiling fixtures are installed. Common in new construction sequence.
project_phase_rules.edge_work_impact: Reduced EdgeLF - only ceiling lines, inside corners, and rough openings. No trim details.
project_phase_rules.production_impact: Faster cut-in and field work due to fewer obstructions

project_phase_rules.name: Post-Trim Installation
project_phase_rules.description: Priming occurs AFTER fixtures, cabinets, trim, and flooring are installed. Requires careful protection and detailed cut-in.
project_phase_rules.edge_work_impact: Increased EdgeLF - includes all trim perimeters, fixture perimeters, outlet/switch plates, etc.
project_phase_rules.production_impact: Slower cut-in due to obstructions. May require additional masking/protection.

assumptions: Drywall is at Level 4 finish standard (joints taped, mudded, sanded by others)
EdgeLF is provided by PaintScope for all cut-in perimeters
Project phase (pre_trim vs post_trim) determines which cut-in task variant applies
Spray application on bare drywall ALWAYS requires immediate wet-on-wet backroll
Dry rolling of sprayed primer is NOT permitted on bare drywall
Single primer coat is baseline; additional coats handled by re-running prime module
Touch-up task rate is estimated at 5-10% of field coverage time
exclusions: Skim coating or Level 5 finish preparation (drywall contractor scope)
Floor protection and masking (separate protection module)
Dry backrolling of sprayed primer (not permitted)
